name: Molytropia
source:
Molytropia: Cloud in Shape of Hurt is the first of seven chapters, which will tell an amazing story about the adventures of a girl and her friends. They will find a strange red door and try to open it, after that everything will begin. You will plunge into the fabulous atmosphere of summer days. Bright warm sun and beautiful landscapes, what could be better? Of course, difficulties are waiting for children on the way, because without them, it can't be called an adventure. The main thing is to remain calm and think clearly.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163450/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Molytropia：Cloud in Shape of Hurt》是七章故事的第一章，講述一個女孩和朋友們的精彩冒險。他們會發現一扇奇怪的紅門，並試著將它開啟；從那一刻起，故事便正式開始。你將沉浸在如夢似幻的夏日氛圍中：明媚溫暖的陽光、美麗的風景，還有什麼比這更好？當然，孩子們的旅途也會遇到困難，畢竟沒有困難就稱不上冒險。最重要的是保持冷靜、清晰思考。

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163450/]Steam[/url]]
